# GENERATED by `hoi4-harness mod-directives` from src/hoi4_harness/modgen.py.
# Do not edit by hand: change the generator and regenerate.

# Telemetry cadence. llmb_tick_hours: 0 or 24 = once a day (the default), 1..12 = the
# event chain, a multiple of 24 = every N days. Set with `effect <TAG> llm_bridge_
# telemetry_every_<H>h` (hoi4-harness: --telemetry-hours). See docs/mod-bridge.md.

# One tick: the state line (with its army, war and probe lines) and the front picture.
llm_bridge_emit_tick = {
	llm_bridge_emit_state = yes
	llm_bridge_emit_front = yes
}

# on_daily, in the player's scope. The three limits are mutually exclusive.
llm_bridge_daily_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours > 24 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { llmb_tick_left = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_left < 1 } }
			set_variable = { llmb_tick_left = llmb_tick_days }
			llm_bridge_emit_tick = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours > 0 } check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours < 24 } }
		# The event chain prints. Every firing sets llmb_tick_alive; a day with none means
		# the event was lost (the country stopped existing), so forget the stuck counter and
		# start the chain again. A live chain fires at least twice a day: never doubled.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_alive < 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 1 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_1 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_1 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 2 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_2 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_2 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 3 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_3 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_3 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 4 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_4 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_4 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 6 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_6 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_6 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 8 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_8 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_8 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 12 } }
				set_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_12 = 0 }
				llm_bridge_tick_schedule_12 = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { llmb_tick_alive = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours < 1 } check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 24 } } }
		llm_bridge_emit_tick = yes
	}
}

llm_bridge_tick_schedule_1 = {
	add_to_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_1 = 1 }
	country_event = { id = llmb_tick.1 hours = 1 }
}

llm_bridge_tick_fire_1 = {
	subtract_from_variable = { llmb_tick_inflight_1 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { llmb_tick_hours = 1 } }
		set_variable = { llmb_tick_alive = 1 }
		if = { limit = { llm_bridge_is_harness = yes } llm_bridge_emit_tick = yes }
		llm_bridge_tick_schedule_1 = yes
	}
}
